description: DC-HUB provides one product-level AstrBot plugin that catalogs DC-Agent plugins by business capability and exposes lifecycle management actions for hot-plug style enable, disable, reload, update, install, and uninstall operations.
acceptance_criteria: DC-HUB registers as one AstrBot plugin named dc_hub with version 0.1.0.
DC-HUB classifies existing DC-Agent plugins into assistant, Feishu collaboration, workflow/Harness, content/media, ops/system, and independent capability groups.
DC-HUB exposes summary, module detail, and lifecycle action APIs for dashboard pages and automation checks.
DC-HUB provides /dc-hub commands to list categories, inspect modules, enable, disable, reload, update, install, and uninstall managed plugins.
Enable and disable actions call AstrBot's plugin lifecycle manager, not only HUB display state.
DC-HUB summary and module payloads count only registered activated plugins as enabled, and expose HUB desired_enabled separately so missing or unloaded modules are never shown as runtime enabled.
Uninstall actions require explicit confirmation and DC-HUB cannot disable or uninstall itself.
Install supports loading an existing local plugin directory or installing from an explicit repository URL.
